Kiyès ki dèyè KONMBIT: yon ekip devlopè: Who is behind KONMBIT: a team of Haitian developers building a payroll and HR platform for Haitian businesses.
KONMBIT se yon platfòm resous imèn ak pe: KONMBIT is an HR and payroll platform built for Haitian businesses, from the small shop to the large company.
Nan Nòdwès peyi a, lè yon plantè gen yon: In the North-West of the country, when a farmer has a big job to do, the neighbors come to help. In Saint-Louis du Nord they call it “kare”, but everyone knows it as “konbit”. Everyone brings their strength, one person coordinates, and work that would have taken a week is done in a day.
Se konsa mwen te grandi, ap gade papa m: That is how I grew up, watching my father farm and hold konbit. We put that idea into software: all the work of managing a team in one place, well coordinated. That includes attendance, leave, payroll, training and recruiting. This way everyone knows their role, and no one wastes time redoing what someone else has already done.
Mwen rele Jivenson Joseph. Mwen fèt e mw: My name is Jivenson Joseph. I was born and raised in Balatye, in Saint-Louis du Nord. I attended primary school at the Rivière des Barres National School (Zabriko), then completed my secondary education at Lycée Jean-Marie de Lamennais in Saint-Louis du Nord.
Mwen etidye enfòmatik biwotik nan Alyans: I studied office computing at the Alliance, then computer science at the Episcopal University of Haiti (UNEPH) in Port-au-Prince. I am a software developer and work with MySQL, Oracle and Access databases. I also work in air conditioning (HVAC) in the United States, where I saw how a field team organizes its work.
Moun ki konnen m konnen mwen renmen apra: People who know me know that I love to learn and to share what I know. I give free computer training at Mamre Church in Port-au-Prince. KONMBIT follows the same idea: take the knowledge and tools that exist elsewhere and put them in the hands of Haitian businesses, in their language, for their reality.
Nou twa se ansyen etidyan UNEPH, e nou s: All three of us studied at UNEPH, and we come from different parts of the country.
